dialogues.opening1: Um, hi.. Oh, am I the first customer..? Uh.. Okay, I can do this I guess.. You’ve got a nice place.
dialogues.opening2: Uhh.. So I’m looking for a dog. A calm one. And um.. Fur makes my nose run, so… Maybe one with less fur? Hard to clean up after too.. It doesn’t have to be super pretty or anything.. But uh, I guess a cute tail could be nice.
dialogues.happy1: Aww.. It's adorable. Thank you. Um, how much does it cost?
dialogues.pazarlik1: Oh.. Okay, I'm sorry.. Um, how much more do I have to pay? Alright, here you go.. Bye.

dialogues.opening1: Hello there― goodness, I went through hell and back just trying to walk through this street. People really have no respect for their elders! Gah, if only my knees weren't hurting..
dialogues.opening2: You look very healthy though, how old are you? You remind me so much of my grandchild!
dialogues.opening3: Well, the kid’s birthday's next week. They grow up so fast nowadays, it's already been 11 years! I've been trying to find a good gift and when I passed by your store, I figured a dog would be an amazing choice. One with big eyes, just like my grandchild! Haha!
dialogues.happy1: Awh, that's an adorable pup! Here, come to granny! Thank you so much sweetheart, here you go.
dialogues.sad1: Oh, not even one? Now that’s no good. Sigh, I need to think of another gift, then. Well, I’ll take a look at the other stores I suppose. Have a great day!
dialogues.pazarlik1: Oh, it costs more? Huh... Well, a few extra bucks aren't worth my grandkid's happiness now, is it? Haha, here you go.

dialogues.opening1: Hello dear! Such a nice weather, isn't it? Beautiful, like my old dog's eyes.. Even thinking about it brings me to tears..
dialogues.opening2: Oh, of course, I'm sorry... I’d gotten my dog from a petshop just like this. It had the prettiest eyes ever.. big and doe-like. This is going to sound selfish of me, but I'd really appreciate a dog with eyes like its.
dialogues.happy1: Its eyes are so bright.. so similar.. Thank you honey, this means so much to me. So, how do I repay you? You deserve a generous tip for sure.
dialogues.sad1: Now that's a shame.. still, thank you for your patience love. Seems I've got other stores I need to check...
dialogues.pazarlik1: Oh? How much more do I need to pay? That's no problem, here you go.

dialogues.opening1: So many flavors.. Uh, hello! Do you have any, um.. What kind of dogs do you have?
dialogues.opening2: I.. I need a pet. To, um... To keep me company, you know.. In the kitchen. Haha...
dialogues.opening3: A big dog is good, very good.. For a meal. O-Oh, I mean... I eat a lot too ― as you can see ― haha. So.. only a dog as big as me should keep me company, right? Haha.. Ha.
dialogues.sad1: Y-You don't? Oh, okay... I can get another one then. No? But.. Why? This is a petshop,  I mean.. I think I should be able to-
dialogues.sad2: ...Whatever, strays are much cheaper anyway.. I hope it won't make me ill, though..
dialogues.happy1: Such a big pup, hehe.. even more meaty than I though.. Sorry, I- Um.. Nevermind. We will have a very nice dinner together.
dialogues.pazarlik1: It costs more?? I-I already paid a lot, you know... Can't you go lower? No?? Come on, it's just a dog. It's one-time use anyway... Whatever, I hope the strays won't make me ill, then..

dialogues.opening1: Hi. -chew chew- So this shop opened, what, days ago? Yeah. Let's see what you've got.
dialogues.opening2: I won't bother with your sloppiness so you better make it quick. If I don't like your work, get ready to be voted 'worst shop of the year', got it?
dialogues.opening3: Get me the most beautiful dog you have. I didn't spend years perfecting myself for some furball to notch me down four levels.
dialogues.opening4: If it's gonna be my dog, then it needs to be the best. Like owner, like pet. Ha!
dialogues.opening5: Gosh, is your brain just sitting in your skull!? That's one star down... That animal better not be below %f cuteness, I literally WON'T touch it! Beauty is the ruler for a reason, duh?
dialogues.opening6: Big eyes, petite body, small nose... The basics, you know? Did you understand? Do I need to spell it out? No?
dialogues.opening7: Okay. Now chop chop. Don't you dare keep me waiting for long.
dialogues.sad1: Oh. Of course you couldn't do your one job. That's on me for walking in thinking someone like you could handle true beauty standards. Anyway, enjoy your one-star review. Bye-bye.
dialogues.happy1: Ew. What's with her fur? ...I didn't walk the whole street for this. It's going straight to a groomer to fix your mess.
dialogues.happy2: Beauty takes more than your bare minimum, though I wouldn't expect you to know. Duh.. Its face is cute though, I suppose..
dialogues.happy3: Whatever, where do I scan my card? Make it quick or I'm dropping you to two stars.
dialogues.pazarlik1: Nuh uhh~ I don't wanna hear it! -chew chew- Bold of you ask for more. It's an accessory, not Aladdin's magic lamp?
dialogues.pazarlik2: Tch, you know what, just take this. I'm losing braincells just from looking at you..

dialogues.opening1: Hehe... Hehehe.. I love dogs.. So much...
dialogues.opening2: Hello... You've got really cute dogs.. Hehe.. I-I love dogs, you know... More than anything.. There's something special about them..
dialogues.opening3: I like small puppies the most.. They're so cute, all energetic, hehe.. I don't like too much fur though.. Too much hassle..
dialogues.opening4: Can I have one of your dogs, please..?
dialogues.happy1: Hehe.. Hehehe.. It's even cuter up close... We're gonna have so much fun, hehe... Thank you.
dialogues.sad1: H-huh? W-Well... I can take another then. You don't ..want me to have puppy..? B-But why?? I'll take very good care of them, I promise..!
dialogues.pazarlik1: M-More? I already paid so much... What's the lowest you'll go?

dialogues.opening1: Hello! Your shop looks veeerry cool!
dialogues.opening2: I want a dog! I want one as a permanent friend. I have no luck with people, it's reaaaally hard to blend in when all people care about is how you look. I didn't have the best time throughout school just because of my skin, haha..
dialogues.opening3: They say animals are 'ugly' when it's not all cutesy. I disagree! What they think is ugly is the prettiest in my eyes!
dialogues.sad1: Aw shucks.. No chance even with dogs? Even doggies don't wanna be my friend, you say..
dialogues.happy1: It's... SO PREEETTTYYYYY, I LOVE ITTTT!! THANK YOU SO SO SOSOSOOO MUCHH!! JUST TAKE MY WALLET PLEASE!!
dialogues.pazarlik1: HERE, TAKE ALL YOU NEED! Oh, leave some though, I need to get it some toys.

dialogues.opening1: Oh, hey. Nice shop I guess, haha.
dialogues.opening2: Uh, I need a dog I guess. I’m spending the money that I was gonna use for topping up, so this is like really important. I want, uh.. Something cheap and cute, you know.
dialogues.opening3: You have those right? Tiny nose, good fur, all that.”And um, like zero responsibility. Eat little, sleep a lot, walk itself, you know, haha.
dialogues.opening4: And uh, I have a question… People say they can’t but like, can they drink beer and stuff? I hope they can ‘cuz I only have that in my place, haha.
dialogues.opening5: Anyway, like I said, I can’t do much work. It should manage itself. It’s already vaccinated, right? They won’t get sick? Hope it’s life will be longer than Luna, haha..
dialogues.happy1: Eh, it’s good, I guess. Can’t you get me a cuter one? I know I didn’t pay enough, but..
dialogues.happy2: Ugh, fine, it’ll do.. Why’s everything so expensive? Could’ve gotten video games instead of this thing.. Take the money already, damnit.
dialogues.sad1: Are you serious?? Like, isn’t this a petshop? You have to have it!
dialogues.sad2: Can you like, call another store? Ask them instead? Tsk, whatever. This place sucks ass dude..
dialogues.pazarlik1: WHAT?? I said cheap for a reason! I-I don’t have that much! That’s like…highkey robbery!
dialogues.pazarlik2: A damn dog can’t be worth like, five video games right? Shouldn’t be! Can’t you go lower? Come on, I need it!

dialogues.opening1: Aye, afternoon to yer good self! The store's mighty fine, haha!
dialogues.opening2: Listen 'ere keeper, I look fo' me treasure. That pesky woman, thinks me passion will begone with a few pills..
dialogues.opening3: This grand treasure, they call a hound. Me treasure be loyal. Eyes be brighter than shiniest of coins. Nose be a sharp as mine. Ears, big ears to track the storms, haha!
dialogues.sad1: Arrr, how come? Other folk be gettin' their treasure just fine! Aye, this port don't hold me treasure then..
dialogues.happy1: Aye aye aye, now that's real treasure! A keeper fo' certain, haha! Now, how be I payin' fo' me treasure?
dialogues.pazarlik1: Aye, you seek more? The beast's hard to let go of fo' shore but ye can take yer pay. The hound's mine now.

dialogues.opening2: A dog... A-Any dog. My.. My other dog gets lonely. It needs another dog. Another meat.. Give me the dog... The bigger the meati-..merrier, I meant merrier..
dialogues.happy1: O-Oh looks.. Looks delicious... Thank you, thank you very much... Tasty, worth a feast.. Take the money...
dialogues.sad1: Why..? My other dog will get lonely if you don't give me the dog.. Please.. No? O-Okay okay, I'll leave.. Just don't tell anybody about this.
dialogues.pazarlik1: I told you last time that I can't pay more, but... Sigh, fine, j-just take it.. Cheaper than other stores..

dialogues.opening2: I need a guard dog. Big dog. Um.. dark fur. Good nose. Can you be quick? I need to leave before junkies gather around the street.
dialogues.happy1: Thanks. Feels weird, trying to protect myself from people just like me.
dialogues.sad1: You don't have a single big dog? ...Tch, should've saved money instead of... Sigh. Okay. Bye.
dialogues.pazarlik1: This is the lowest you'll go? ...Fine. Pot has to wait, I guess..

dialogues.opening1: So this is the place? Peh, trashy. You, where's your boss? Need to talk to him. What are you, deaf?
dialogues.opening2: Go get me your boss like a good employee. ..You're the boss? Hah! They let anyone become a boss nowadays, hahahaha!
dialogues.opening3: You should've been scrubbing toilets, lickin' a real boss' boot if you're lucky.. Alright now twat, listen up.
dialogues.opening4: Get me the big dogs. All of 'em. I'm gonna be straight with you, they'll be my personal corpse dispensers once I'm through with 'em.
dialogues.opening5: Their little bellies are so so full, huh? Hah! Weak asses. All playtime and expensive food. Tch..
dialogues.opening6: Better get used to feelin' full with carcass. They're useless shit otherwise. Hahahahaha!
dialogues.opening7: What, you wanna join your doggies in my backyard or something? Teeth at carcass with them? Hahahaha!
dialogues.opening8: See the store across from ya? Delicious food. I wonder where the taste comes from... Hahahaha!
dialogues.opening9: You gonna listen or you gonna lick my boot? Hahahaha! Get me my fuckin' dogs!
dialogues.happy1: This all you've got? Good. Hahaha... I'll set your ass on fire if I find out you're lyin' to me. To me
dialogues.happy2: Can this thing even bite, huh? Or can it only chew the cute ass food you give them?
dialogues.happy3: You really haven't learnt who I am yet, huh? It better be useful, or I'll ruin this cute little shop you've got forever. 'Kay?
dialogues.sad1: Haha... HAHAHAHAHA! The hell ya mean you don't? You're a damn petshop! You really don't know who I am, huh?
dialogues.sad2: You've got some backbone, I'll give ya that.? Hahahaha! But..
dialogues.sad3: Fine, you'll pay for this. Keep your eyes peeled for your poor little doggies!
dialogues.pazarlik1: Oho, you're a brave one, aren't you? I can appreciate that. Hahaha! You're lucky I gave you money as it is. Even luckier that I don't shoot you dead right here. Dipshit.
dialogues.pazarlik2: I'll give you five more, not a penny above that. Ask for more and I'll crack your skull open. You'll get around fine here if you just do as I say, kid.
dialogues.pazarlik3: Wait 'till I teach you your last lesson. You can't escape from this that easy! HAHAHAHA!
